analytical-qc.samples.label: Samples & batches
analytical-qc.samples.description: Describe material, batch identity and acceptance criteria.
analytical-qc.methods.label: Methods & calibration
analytical-qc.methods.description: Connect method versions, calibration records and uncertainty information.
analytical-qc.runs.label: Analytical runs
analytical-qc.runs.description: Record run context, standards and raw-data references.
analytical-qc.investigations.label: Quality investigations
analytical-qc.investigations.description: Retain original results and document deviations and decisions.
arts-creative.ideas.label: Ideas & inquiries
arts-creative.ideas.description: Explore intentions, questions and references without needing a fixed outcome.
arts-creative.studies.label: Studies & material trials
arts-creative.studies.description: Document sketches, material tests, techniques and iterations, including attempts you set aside.
arts-creative.works.label: Works & editions
arts-creative.works.description: Describe a work, composition or installation, its version and how it may be used. Add people and collectives through Contributors.
arts-creative.sessions.label: Rehearsals & recordings
arts-creative.sessions.description: Keep rehearsal, performance development and recording sessions connected to the works and collaborators involved.
arts-creative.presentations.label: Exhibitions & performances
arts-creative.presentations.description: Plan and document exhibitions, gigs, screenings, releases and other presentations.
arts-creative.collections.label: Collections & care
arts-creative.collections.description: Describe collection items and their history, condition and care. Record uncertainty and the sources behind attribution.
arts-creative.loans.label: Loans & movements
arts-creative.loans.description: Document incoming or outgoing work, locations, dates and agreement references. Link the work or collection record in Related work.
arts-creative.reflection.label: Reflection & critique
arts-creative.reflection.description: Capture individual or collective reflection, responses and decisions for future practice.
audio-software.dsp.label: DSP prototype
audio-software.dsp.description: State the signal path, parameter behavior and intended comparison. Keep a prototype or preview separate from an exported plug-in tested in a host.
audio-software.build.label: Build & export
audio-software.build.description: Retain the source snapshot, tool versions, build settings, exported binary and build log as evidence. A successful export does not establish correct behavior in every host.
audio-software.host-test.label: Host & real-time test
audio-software.host-test.description: Record validator results and actual host behavior separately. Retain logs and rendered audio; report unsupported or untested combinations explicitly.
audio-software.host-test.fields.field3: Audio device / sample rate / buffer size
audio-software.listening.label: Listening comparison
audio-software.listening.description: Describe the question and retain comparable audio examples. State level matching, monitoring and limitations; subjective preference and measured behavior are distinct evidence.
audio-software.release.label: Release decision
audio-software.release.description: Link the exact export and tests considered. Keep saving, export, validation, host testing and publication as distinct events.
beekeeping.apiary.label: Apiary register
beekeeping.apiary.description: Identify the site and its responsible keeper. Keep dated movement records when its hive population changes.
beekeeping.hive.label: Hive register
beekeeping.hive.description: Use a stable hive identifier. The hive is equipment; the colony occupying it may change. Link its colony and apiary records, and record changes as dated events.
beekeeping.hive.fields.equipment: Hive format, boxes and frame sizes
beekeeping.colony.label: Colony register
beekeeping.colony.description: Give the colony its own identity. Link its hive; record splits, unions and requeening as separate events so an earlier inspection keeps its meaning.
beekeeping.colony.fields.queen-origin: Queen origin and age, if known
beekeeping.inspection.label: Hive inspection
beekeeping.inspection.description: Link the hive and, when known, its colony. Record what you actually checked; an unseen queen is not proof of queenlessness. Use the record date for the visit and leave unmeasured quantities blank.
beekeeping.inspection.fields.queen-cells: Queen cells: count, stage and position
beekeeping.inspection.fields.stores: Honey / nectar and pollen stores, with estimate units
beekeeping.inspection.fields.health: Abnormal signs / suspected causes / unexamined areas
beekeeping.inspection.fields.actions: Actions actually taken and equipment changes
beekeeping.monitoring.label: Health monitoring
beekeeping.monitoring.description: Record the method and its raw counts together. Different sampling methods and durations are not interchangeable. Link diagnostic reports as evidence; distinguish suspicion from a confirmed result.
beekeeping.care.label: Feeding & treatment
beekeeping.care.description: Log the actual intervention. Retain the product instructions or professional advice used; these prompts do not recommend a product or dose. Record later response in a new monitoring or inspection record.
beekeeping.movement.label: Hive & equipment movement
beekeeping.movement.description: Identify every affected hive. Link the hive or colony records. Record the origin, destination and responsible parties; temporary moves also need the stay dates.
beekeeping.movement.fields.identifiers: Hive identifiers / equipment and comb identifiers
beekeeping.colony-event.label: Colony event
beekeeping.colony-event.description: Retain separate colony identities through splits, unions, loss and replacement. Link all affected colony and hive records; do not overwrite earlier inspections.
beekeeping.colony-event.fields.before: Before: colony, hive and queen identifiers
beekeeping.colony-event.fields.after: After: colony, hive and queen identifiers
beekeeping.harvest.label: Harvest & batch
beekeeping.harvest.description: Link each contributing hive. Keep harvest and extraction dates distinct, and retain the batch identity through storage or processing.
beekeeping.tracking.subject: Hive / colony
biosafety-containment.assessments.label: Risk assessments
biosafety-containment.assessments.descri: Document activity-specific assessment and responsible review.
biosafety-containment.training.label: Training & competency
biosafety-containment.training.descripti: Record training evidence, scope and reassessment needs.
biosafety-containment.facilities.label: Facilities & equipment assurance
biosafety-containment.incidents.label: Incidents & follow-up
biosafety-containment.incidents.descript: Document incidents and corrective actions through local procedures.
clinical-medical.requests.label: Requests & accessioning
clinical-medical.requests.description: Document request and specimen references without copying unnecessary identifying data.
clinical-medical.methods.label: Methods & verification
clinical-medical.methods.description: Describe intended use, method revisions and verification evidence.
clinical-medical.quality.label: Quality & exceptions
clinical-medical.quality.description: Document controls, issues and follow-up investigations.
clinical-medical.reports.label: Reporting & follow-up
clinical-medical.reports.description: Document reporting procedures and follow-up work.
computer-it.environments.label: Environments & builds
computer-it.environments.description: Record software, dependencies, configuration and hardware.
computer-it.datasets.label: Datasets & provenance
computer-it.datasets.description: Document dataset versions, origin and permitted use.
computer-it.runs.label: Runs & benchmarks
computer-it.runs.description: Record inputs, configurations, seeds, outputs and comparisons.
computer-it.findings.label: Findings & validation
computer-it.findings.description: Connect results, limitations and reproduction instructions.
crime-forensic.cases.label: Cases & requests
crime-forensic.cases.description: Record scoped case references and examination questions.
crime-forensic.evidence.label: Evidence documentation
crime-forensic.evidence.description: Describe evidence references and preservation context.
crime-forensic.examinations.label: Examination notes
crime-forensic.examinations.description: Connect method versions, observations and supporting artifacts.
crime-forensic.reports.label: Review & reporting
crime-forensic.reports.description: Document review questions, limitations and report references.
educational.activities.label: Learning activities
educational.activities.description: Define learning objectives, preparation and accessible instructions.
educational.sessions.label: Classes & sessions
educational.sessions.description: Plan sessions and link equipment, resources and supervision.
educational.work.label: Learner investigations
educational.feedback.label: Feedback & reflection
environmental-agricultural.sites.label: Sites & plots
environmental-agricultural.sites.descrip: Describe location, sampling context and plot history.
environmental-agricultural.campaigns.des: Define study questions, sampling design and quality objectives.
Record environmental conditions, treatments and observations.
environmental-agricultural.results.label: Measurements & interpretation
environmental-agricultural.results.descr: Connect methods, units, detection limits and interpretation.
physical-prototyping.design.label: Design & revision
physical-prototyping.design.description: Record the purpose, schematic or mechanical revision and controlled changes. Attach original design files as evidence; link the exact method used.
physical-prototyping.design.fields.field: Electrical and design-rule checks / unresolved issues
physical-prototyping.assembly.label: Assembly & bill of materials
physical-prototyping.assembly.descriptio: Identify each physical build. Use Inventory > Bills of materials to plan and reserve components, then record actual use and scrap. DNP means do not populate; it must not consume stock.
physical-prototyping.bring-up.label: Bring-up & measurements
physical-prototyping.bring-up.descriptio: Keep preparation, physical execution and interpretation separate. Record equipment, limits and actual measurements; a design check or simulation alone does not establish a working physical build.
physical-prototyping.rework.label: Rework & repeat
physical-prototyping.rework.description: Record what changed and why. Retain the original run and BOM; create a new BOM for additional parts and a separate run for the repeated test.
physical-prototyping.findings.label: Prototype findings
physical-prototyping.findings.descriptio: Connect measurements and observed limitations to the design decision. Record open questions without forcing a pass/fail outcome.
research-development.questions.label: Questions & hypotheses
research-development.questions.descripti: State the question, competing explanations and success criteria.
research-development.protocols.label: Protocols & methods
research-development.protocols.descripti: Describe the method, its version and conditions.
research-development.experiments.label: Experiments & prototypes
research-development.experiments.descrip: Connect the setup, inputs, observations and deviations.
research-development.findings.label: Findings & decisions
research-development.findings.descriptio: Connect evidence, uncertainty, conclusions and follow-up work.
software-development.repository.label: Repository register
software-development.repository.descript: Give each repository or product a stable identity. Record its address and default branch exactly; builds, images and releases link back to it.
software-development.change.label: Change & experiment
software-development.change.description: Record one change or experiment against an exact starting commit. Keep the goal, the approach and the outcome together; abandoned work remains valid evidence.
software-development.build.label: Build
software-development.build.description: Record what was built, from which exact commit, with which tools and parameters, and the digests of what came out. A build that cannot be reproduced bit for bit says so.
software-development.image.label: Disk & container image
software-development.image.description: Identify each disk, container, virtual machine or firmware image by name and digest. Link the build it came from and record where the exact bytes are kept.
software-development.image.fields.name: Image name / tag
software-development.test-run.label: Test run
software-development.test-run.descriptio: Record what was tested, where and how, with the raw counts. Keep failed, skipped and flaky results; a partial run is not a pass.
software-development.test-run.fields.iss: Failures, flaky tests and known issues
software-development.release.label: Release
software-development.release.description: Identify the release by version, tag and exact commit, and record the digests of what was published. Link the builds, tests and decision behind it.
software-development.deployment.label: Deployment & installation
software-development.deployment.descript: Record where a release was installed, how, and whether the installed bytes matched the published digest.
software-development.incident.label: Defect & incident
software-development.incident.descriptio: Describe what was observed against what was expected, with exact affected versions and reproduction steps. Link the change that fixed it.
software-development.decision.label: Design decision
software-development.decision.descriptio: Record one architectural or design decision with its context, the alternatives considered and the consequences. A replaced decision stays, marked as superseded.
software-development.tracking.subject: Repository, build, image or release
